entities.summary: Prienai is a city in Lithuania situated on the Nemunas River, 29 km (18 mi) south of Kaunas. In 2023, the city had 8,894 inhabitants. The name of the city is a derivative from the surname Prienas. Pociūnai Airport is associated with the city. Prienai is a city in Northern Europe, established around 1502. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
